standing: Author reference checks on exact admitted TS Run; synthetic host observations; not independent query reconstruction or storage/engine qualification.

checks.name: retained outgoing import
checks.basis: Exact retained source endpoint and one resolved import edge.

checks.name: retained incoming empty disclosure
checks.basis: Empty retained traversal includes evidence limitations; never a proof that no callers/importers exist globally.

checks.name: retained reach
checks.basis: One reachable endpoint in this retained graph.

checks.name: explicit historical Run unaffected by latest
checks.basis: Changing host.latestRunId does not change an explicit Run-bound response.

checks.name: work-bound emptiness not exact absence
checks.basis: Limit hit with owed work is indeterminate, even when no items were returned.

checks.name: wrong Run refused
checks.basis: An unrelated requested Run cannot borrow this evidence.

checks.name: purged evidence unavailable
checks.basis: Trusted current availability refuses as unavailable rather than returning an empty graph.
